title: LLM-enabled Behavior Driven Development Workflow for Formally Verified Hardware Designs
abstract: arXiv:2609.15318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recently, the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) for different tasks in the Electronic Design Automation (EDA) life-cycle has been studied extensively, but an integrated view is lacking. Specifications are the foundation of this life-cycle, but they suffer from ambiguity when written in natural language, which especially affects the quality of LLM output. Formal specifications mitigate these ambiguities, but they come with their own challenges. On the other hand, Controlled Natural Language (CNL) specifications can serve as a middle-ground, reducing ambiguity while retaining interpretability. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的行为驱动开发工作流用于形式化验证的硬件设计
translated_abstract: 近年来，大语言模型在电子设计自动化生命周期中各类任务的应用已得到广泛研究，但目前缺乏一个整体视角。规格说明是该生命周期的基础，但用自然语言编写的规格说明存在歧义问题，这尤其会影响大语言模型输出的质量。形式化规格说明可以缓解这些歧义，但其自身也带来了挑战。另一方面，受控自然语言规格说明可以作为一种折中方案，在降低歧义性的同时保持可解释性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个关于大语言模型在EDA中应用的整体视角，并建立了一个由大语言模型支持的行为驱动硬件开发工作流。我们引入并定义了形式化验证Gherkin场景（FV Gherkin场景），从而将受控自然语言规格说明作为通过形式化属性验证实现形式化验证硬件设计的基础。
tldr: 本文提出了大语言模型在EDA中应用的整体视角，并引入形式化验证Gherkin场景（FV Gherkin场景），以受控自然语言规格说明为基础，建立了可实现形式化验证硬件设计的大语言模型行为驱动开发工作流。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an integrated view of LLM usage in EDA and introduces Formal Verification Gherkin Scenarios (FV Gherkin Scenarios), establishing an LLM-enabled behavior-driven hardware development workflow that uses Controlled Natural Language specifications as the foundation for formally verified hardware designs.
